verdict.rationale: Composio is a SaaS platform that stores user credentials and handles tool data, so a buyer could fairly ask about retention and deletion controls. The evidence pack never documents retention settings, deletion of stored data or connected accounts, or any data-lifecycle controls. Docs only state that Composio stores and refreshes credentials, which is not user control over retention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
